name: B10-0062/2024 (PfE) – The devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
title: Resolution on the devastating floods in central and eastern Europe, the loss of lives and the EU’s preparedness to act on such disasters exacerbated by climate change
part_text:
The Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its position on the recent floods in Central and Eastern Europe. It offers sympathy to victims and thanks to rescue teams. It asks the European Union to pay disaster aid from its Solidarity Fund quickly and without bureaucratic conditions. It also calls for better cross-border flood prevention, faster help through the EU Civil Protection Mechanism, and enough money for prevention projects.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission and Council to act.
- **Who it affects:** Flood-hit countries: Austria, Czechia, Germany, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and member states.
